## Accepted completion obligations
No contract IDs were assigned. These are exactly three Plan obligations, identified by this heading and their row positions:
1. Preserve the existing version field when saving an updated delivery record.
2. Confirm a delivery record can be read through the external tenant endpoint.
3. Confirm that the existing timestamp remains unchanged when a record is read.
No additional completion obligations exist.
cases.workResult: Implementation and checks completed with gaps. The record save check at tests/delivery.test.js:14 ran with node --test tests/delivery.test.js against src/delivery.js:9 on Node v25.7.0 and failed: existing version=17, actual saved version=0; exit 1. The external endpoint is additionally unavailable because this runner has no tenant credential; this does not explain or undo the observed local version failure. For the endpoint read check, src/tenant-client.js:21 is implemented, and node scripts/tenant-probe.js exited 2 before making a request with MISSING_TENANT_CREDENTIAL; the runner has no tenant credential, and there is no observed implementation failure for that obligation. For the timestamp read check, no command ran and no timestamp result was observed; the reason is unknown. No alternative verification was performed for the endpoint or timestamp. The remaining risks are endpoint interoperability and timestamp retention. No new obligations were discovered.
